summary: Membership in banned organization; constitutional validity of Section 10(i) UAPA; standard: active knowing membership with intent to further unlawful aims required, not mere association; guilt by association doctrine rejected; reference to larger bench due to procedural concerns over prior rulings without Union of India's participation; implications for Articles 19 and 21 violations.
legal_provisions_cited: Kedar Nath vs. State of Bihar
final_judgment: Reference made to larger bench; interim status of prior judgments on membership liability suspended pending reconsideration.
